jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists with a track record protecting defenders across specific regions, which the candidate lacks, and it is not a genuine salaried vacancy. The human-rights/securitisation subject is genuinely interesting, but the advisory-expert framing is a hard mismatch for an early-career applicant.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter (London only) and this role is based in Washington, DC with no London option. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow role well above entry level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at a think-tank is a senior, experienced research position well above entry level, requiring an established policy track record the candidate lacks. The climate-development topic also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.
